frame_fit: Flank receiving slots changed from source 5 mm to actual CAD frame nominal 6 mm. Keel slot retained at nominal 6 mm. Actual plywood thickness/kerf and dry-fit contact still required. Do not force plate or remove whole rear frame.
limits: Confirm actual motor label and template against holes before manufacture.
Measure safe threaded engagement and actual washer/plate stack; M3x8/M3x10 not approved automatically.
Confirm enclosed ASA-capable printer, spool and manufacturer temperature profile; ownedprinter unknown.
Manufacturer93C heat-resistance statement is not an allowable service temperature or aircraft loadrating. Measure actual mount temperature/creep at intended propulsion loads.
Actual metalM3washers spread head pressure; measure OD/stack/driveraccess and avoid unsupported washer across shaftrelief. No torque value invented.
Qualify ASA-to-plywood epoxy coupon; do not use woodglue on plastic. The original butt/slot loadpath requires physical bond/loadproof.
If clamp relaxation, warping, delamination, woodbond failure or thermal distortion occurs, stop; no flight approval.
orientation: Front (forward/low-Y) broad face on bed, motor/aft face upward; installed geometry rotated +90deg aboutX then translated. Screw axis printsZ; full6mm thickness is solid. No supports inside keyhole or flank slots.
design_status: Printable prototype requiring physical motor/wood joint, clamp, vibration, thermal and thrust/torque qualification. No load or safe operating temperature established.
manufacturing: 3D print ASA; old wood A26 superseded and excluded current production panels. No laser-cut replacement requested.
design_reason: ASA chosen for higher heat resistance and outdoor toughness vs ownedPLA+. Solid100% infill avoids sparse-infill clamp crush and distributes thrust/torque around screws and frame seats;6walls protects apertures. Broad-face orientation gives continuous in-plane torque paths and flat metal-base seating. Thrust normalplate, layer separation, screw preload creep and plastic/wood adhesive remain unproven. No extra reinforcement/metalbacking dimensions invented; qualify actual washer/head contact and screwdriver access with hardware.
